quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the slowest speed you can drive. You must not drive slower than the speed shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see this sign. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of situation does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you about construction ahead. Follow the sign to take a different route around the construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you the direction you must drive on this street. Traffic only moves in one direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you about construction. Penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you about construction. A flagger is ahead. Watch for the flagger and follow their directions.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross first. Look for children and be ready to stop at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows you can turn left or go straight from this lane at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What should you do at this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs show you an alternate route because the main road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The ground slopes down to the tracks. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the rails.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: This is an eight-sided stop sign. Come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and traffic from all directions. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: This sign is a warning that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you traffic moves in one direction only. When turning onto this street, you must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. A sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. The road will become a divided highway soon.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane will end ahead. Merge left safely.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and let pedestrians and other traffic pass. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign. A new lane is being added to the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a roundabout ahead. Slow down when entering and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you the road is covered with loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers:

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end soon. Drivers in that lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you will drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, it shows 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending and they must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted in parking lots. It marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a narrow bridge with tight lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic from both directions can use the center lane to turn left only. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. Follow any instructions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on green, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road shoulder is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. If you follow a driver using this signal, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that U-turns are not permitted at this location. All drivers must obey regulation signs.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This puts you at risk of a head-on collision. Turn around safely as soon as possible.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about workers on or near the road. Drive carefully and slowly through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure all vehicles and pedestrians have cleared the way before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs show that the traffic pattern or route ahead has changed due to construction or work. Follow the detour signs to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Watch for people entering or crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that construction is starting ahead. Slow down and be careful around construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. Trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that lanes are moving. Follow the lane as it shifts.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane ends at an exit ramp. If you stay in that lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you to stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of an overpass. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign like this is only used to warn of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. Do not drive into an intersection if traffic is blocked.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction will change the normal route. Be ready to follow a different path ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a school crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for traffic entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is cleaning up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must move into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the road ahead has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a nearby fire station. Watch for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit tell you?

options.text: It is only a recommended speed.
You must drive at exactly this speed to avoid a ticket.
This is the maximum safe speed in good conditions.
This is the maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: This is the maximum safe speed in good conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower when conditions are bad. Always adjust your speed to conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular. You must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and crossing traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead only allows one-way traffic.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the bridge ahead is narrow. Be careful when meeting or passing trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a divided highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride near traffic. Drive slowly and watch for bicycles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park here at any time. You must follow all regulation signs.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always have red on top and green on bottom when arranged vertically. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden stops or turns, and increase your distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. It recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be prepared to stop at a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop. Yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the right lane ahead will be closed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It means a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply. Slow down before reaching the sharp turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the roadway. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols or words. They warn you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road you are on will end ahead.
You must turn either right or left.
A road will join from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves left. You may see several chevron signs along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.
